name: ARES learned route cost
about: Terrain cost learned from the routes Perseverance's drivers chose (maximum margin planning, Ratliff et al. 2006, 2009), with the safety rule: never less careful than the physics model. Off by default; used only if passed to planRoute as routeGrid. Changes route shape only: no-go cells stay no-go, and walking time, oxygen and status come from the Contract 2 model. Made by pipeline/learn_route_cost.py; results in docs/route-learning.md.
assumption: Rover drivers' choices stand in for expert route choice. A rover is not an astronaut: its limits on slope, rocks and sand differ, so the learned preferences are a proxy.
costRatio: cost per meter / cost per meter on flat firm ground = walk_time^a x exp(sum of weight x feature), a = log_walk_time weight

features.about: log of walking time per meter from the Contract 2 model divided by the time on flat firm ground; its weight a is a power: walk_time^a
1 if thermal inertia is under 175 (soft sand), else 0
How loose the ground is: (250 - thermal inertia) / 75, clipped to 0..1
1 if a no-go cell is within 2 cells (about 50 m), else 0

evaluation.method: Blocked 5-fold cross-validation in driving order; learned models never see the block they are scored on
evaluation.metric_mean_dev_m: Mean distance between the planned route and the rover's real route, measured both ways, meters (lower = closer to the experts)
